read_first: only the explicit formation registry when operational formations are causally relevant
role-slot registry only when an unmaterialized office, vacancy or succession is causal
for clan activity, load the exact active clan owner plus its cold clan profile; never substitute the static profile for mutable membership, leadership, resources or access
write_order: conserve source manpower and availability partitions
update exact formation state only for operational bodies that are materialized
update role-slot continuity when vacancy, succession or officeholder materialization changes
for House Tang, settle rostered individual-lite profiles through the one bounded person-core registry and then recompute House cohort summaries from those people
for large clan institutions, update the active clan owner once for aggregate cohort membership/training/process changes; never fan routine clan progression out across every represented person
update genuinely separate authorities such as stock only when causally changed
rebuild derived routing indexes only when necessary
invariants: A force is the single aggregate manpower owner.
Explicit formation headcount is a subset of deployed force personnel and never exceeds it.
A force may have deployed personnel that remain abstract until an operation requires explicit formation state.
A named exact team embedded in a formation is included in formation headcount rather than added to it.
One semantic mutable fact has one writable owner; sidecars exist only for genuinely separate authority or rebuildable derived data.
House member_ids contains every persistent House identity, whether exact or roster-core backed.

House Tang is a small personal institution: each rostered member owns persistent individual-lite capability/development state in the bounded person-core registry; House cohorts are organization/training assignments and derived summaries.
A House review may settle many embedded member profiles in one registry write and then rebuild cohort summaries; efficiency never makes the cohort the owner of an individual member capability.

An active clan-institution owns only current campaign clan facts; its cold clan profile is static sourced reference and cannot substitute for current leadership, membership, facilities, resources, politics or technique access.

Clan training uses the generic training reducer and conserved elapsed time; clan membership, ancestry or reputation never grants free progression, hereditary expression, secret access, technique knowledge or mastery.
Routine large-clan cohort development is one aggregate capability-host write and must conserve its represented identities/headcount.
An unmaterialized role slot is institutional continuity state, never a hidden person sheet.
Materializing an officeholder preserves incumbency and may not grant free capability, knowledge, equipment, relationships, authority or retroactive outcome convenience.
Large-force operations separate source ownership, command authority, operational attachment and location; an operation never becomes a second manpower owner.

Living-world world-operation records are causal work owners only; they reference missions, projects, cases, claims, routes and resources but never become duplicate authority for manpower, money, inventory, population, legal status or territorial control.
